conventions: Format with Prettier defaults (2-space indent, double quotes, trailing commas, semicolons).

Follow ESLint import/order: builtin, external, @excalidraw/** (external after), internal, parent, sibling, index, object, type; always leave an empty line between every import statement (newlines-between: always-and-inside-groups).
Use separate type imports (`import type { ... } from ...`) to satisfy `@typescript-eslint/consistent-type-imports` with zero ESLint warnings.
Never import from the barrel `packages/excalidraw/index.tsx` inside non-test source files; use direct relative imports such as `import type { BoxSelectionMode } from "../types"`.
Tests run under Vitest with jsdom and use `render`, `act`, `API`, `Pointer`, `Keyboard`, and `assertSelectedElements` from `packages/excalidraw/tests/test-utils` and `./helpers/*`.

decisions.topic: Mode parameter name and default on getLassoSelectedElementIds
decisions.choice: Accept optional `boxSelectionMode?: BoxSelectionMode` on `getLassoSelectedElementIds` input object, defaulting to `"overlap"` when omitted.
decisions.reason: Preserves backward compatibility for existing direct callers in `lasso.test.tsx` while matching `appState.boxSelectionMode` naming when `LassoTrail.updateSelection` passes `this.app.state.boxSelectionMode`.

decisions.topic: Element and bound-text enclosure in contain vs overlap mode
decisions.choice: In `"contain"` mode, skip bound-to-container text elements (`isBoundToContainer(element)`) on their own, require non-empty element segments with every segment endpoint inside `lassoPolygon` and zero `lassoSegments` intersecting `element`, and for arrows (`isArrowElement(element)`) with bound text (`getBoundTextElement`) also require the positioned bound text (`computeBoundTextPosition` + `getElementLineSegments`) to have all segment endpoints inside `lassoPolygon` and zero `lassoSegments` intersecting it.
rejected: Treating bound-to-container text on non-arrow containers as selectable or required in `"contain"` mode
decisions.reason: Matches `elementsOverlappingBBox` semantics while accurately handling concave lasso polygons across all shapes supported by `getElementLineSegments`.

decisions.topic: Group selection filtering in contain mode
decisions.choice: After collecting individually enclosed elements in `"contain"` mode, remove any enclosed element with `element.groupIds.length > 0` unless every non-deleted, unlocked, non-bound-text element in the scene (`elementsMap` and `elements`) whose `groupIds` includes `element.groupIds.at(-1)` is also in `enclosedElements`.
rejected: Allowing locked or bound-text group members to block group selection in `"contain"` mode
decisions.reason: Ensures off-screen or un-enclosed selectable group members block top-level group selection while locked and bound-text elements do not, matching `elementsOverlappingBBox`.

units.behaviour: Make getLassoSelectedElementIds mode-aware across "contain" (Wrap) and "overlap" (Overlap) modes for outlines, concave polygons, arrow and container bound text, and groups.
rules: 1. Import `getElementLineSegments`, `isArrowElement`, and `isBoundToContainer` from `@excalidraw/element`, and `import type { BoxSelectionMode } from "../types"` (with a blank line between every import statement).
2. Extend `getLassoSelectedElementIds` input type with `boxSelectionMode?: BoxSelectionMode` and default `const { ..., boxSelectionMode = "overlap" } = input;`.

3. When `boxSelectionMode === "contain"`, skip any element in `unlockedElements` where `isBoundToContainer(element)` is `true` so bound-to-container text never counts on its own and never selects its container.
4. Retain the `doBoundsIntersect(lassoBounds, elementBounds)` pre-filter before running polygon inclusion or segment intersection checks.

5. In `"contain"` mode, consider `element` enclosed if and only if: (a) `elementsSegments.get(element.id)` exists with `segments.length > 0` and every point of every segment satisfies `polygonIncludesPointNonZero(point, lassoPolygon)`, (b) no segment in the closed `lassoSegments` intersects `element` (`intersectElementWithLineSegment(element, elementsMap, lassoSegment, 0, true).length === 0`), and (c) if `isArrowElement(element)` and `getBoundTextElement(element, elementsMap)` returns a `boundTextElement`, the positioned bound text `{ ...boundTextElement, ...computeBoundTextPosition(element, boundTextElement, elementsMap) }` has non-empty `getElementLineSegments(positionedBoundText, elementsMap)` with all segment endpoints inside `lassoPolygon` and zero `lassoSegments` intersecting `positionedBoundText`. Add enclosed elements to `enclosedElements` only; never add partially enclosed or intersected elements in `"contain"` mode.

6. In `"overlap"` mode, preserve existing behaviour: an unlocked element whose bounds intersect `lassoBounds` is added to `enclosedElements` if at least one segment endpoint is inside `lassoPolygon`, or else added to `intersectedElements` if any closed lasso segment intersects `element` or its positioned `boundTextElement`.

7. After the element loop, when `boxSelectionMode === "contain"` and `enclosedElements.size > 0`, build a map of all scene elements from `elementsMap.values()` and `elements`, and for each `id` in `[...enclosedElements]` whose element has `const topGroupId = element.groupIds.at(-1)`, remove `id` from `enclosedElements` if any element in the scene map satisfies `!sceneElement.isDeleted && !sceneElement.locked && !isBoundToContainer(sceneElement) && sceneElement.groupIds.includes(topGroupId) && !enclosedElements.has(sceneElement.id)`.

tests.expect: Selected elements is empty in "contain" mode and contains the rectangle in "overlap" mode

tests.name: selects fully enclosed rectangle, diamond, ellipse, rotated shape, line, arrow, and freedraw in contain mode
tests.given: Unlocked rectangle, diamond, ellipse, rotated rectangle, line, arrow, and freedraw stroke inside a surrounding lasso polygon in "contain" mode

tests.given: A rectangle whose AABB intersects a concave U-shaped lasso's bounds while part of its outline lies in the concave notch outside the polygon
tests.expect: Selected elements is empty in "contain" mode and contains the rectangle in "overlap" mode

tests.name: requires arrow bound text label to be enclosed in contain mode
tests.given: An arrow with a bound text label whose computed label bounds extend beyond the arrow shaft
tests.expect: A lasso enclosing only the arrow shaft selects nothing in "contain" mode, while a lasso enclosing both the arrow and its bound label selects the arrow

tests.name: ignores rectangle bound text label in contain mode while selecting container in overlap mode
tests.given: A rectangle with a bound text label and a lasso path completely inside the rectangle that encloses only the bound label
tests.expect: Selected elements is empty in "contain" mode and contains the rectangle in "overlap" mode

tests.name: enforces top-level, nested, off-screen, locked, and bound-text group rules in contain and overlap modes
tests.given: Grouped elements including two-member groups, nested inner/outer groups, an off-screen group member, a locked group member, and a bound-text group member
tests.expect: In "contain" mode, a group is selected only when all selectable scene members of its top-level group are enclosed (locked and bound-text members do not block); in "overlap" mode, touching one member selects the whole group

tests.name: preserves frame child exclusion and additive selection in contain mode
tests.given: A frame with child elements and a pre-selected element with keepPreviousSelection=true in "contain" mode
tests.expect: Enclosing the frame and its children selects only the frame, and keepPreviousSelection=true retains the previously selected element
